Definition: Betser, a place in Palestine; also an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Bezer = "gold ore" or "remote fortress"; n pr m; 1) son of Zophah, one of the heads of the houses of Asher; n pr loc; 2) a city of refuge in Reuben in the downs on the east of the Jordan
